bundles.name: The Time Capsule Collection
bundles.blurb: In 1887 a Warsaw eye doctor published Esperanto, a language that belongs to no country. Nishane borrowed it to name five extraits, then sent each one to a far edge of the map. Kredo means belief, and its label reads Auckland: osmanthus and cardamom over oud and suede. Tempfluo, time flow, is Anchorage, praline and orange blossom slowing the clock. Papilefiko, the butterfly effect, is Reykjavík, fir balsam, styrax and moss. Deziro, desire, is Malé, mandarin and sea air. Tero, earth, is Ushuaia, salted caramel at the bottom of the world. Five words, five cities, sealed in one set.

bundles.name: The tea 'X' flames Collection
bundles.blurb: Two Nishane icons and the remixes they inspired, poured side by side. Nishane named Fan Your Flames after a line from the 13th-century poet Rumi: set your life on fire, and seek out those who fan your flames. The original answers with rum, coconut and tobacco; its X keeps the fire going and throws on thyme and mastic, the resin of the Greek island of Chios. Wulong Cha takes its name from oolong, wūlóng in Chinese, the black dragon tea, with Shanghai on its label: bergamot and orange steeped over nutmeg and fig. Its X, by Julien Rasquinet, opens the tea-house window with green tea and magnolia. A bonfire and a tea ceremony, each with its echo.

bundles.name: The Nishane XXX Collection
bundles.blurb: An X usually crosses something out. At Nishane it marks a second draft. Hundred Silent Ways takes its name from Rumi: “I closed my mouth and spoke to you in a hundred silent ways.” Its X says it after dark, tuberose and gardenia wrapped in vanilla, leather and patchouli. Fan Your Flames X walks the rum-and-tobacco original through an herb garden of thyme and mastic. Wulong Cha X lets the oolong cool and blossom into green tea, magnolia and fig. Three classics, rewritten by the house that wrote them.

bundles.name: The Born in Roma Collection
bundles.blurb: Valentino was born in Rome in 1960, and every bottle in this line wears the house's Rockstud, studs cut into the glass like a couture jacket. 7am: Green Stravaganza, espresso and bergamot over green vetiver. 1pm: Yellow Dream, mandarin and pineapple melting into gingerbread and vanilla while the city naps. 7pm, when the light turns gold on the stone: Coral Fantasy, red apple, sage and a curl of tobacco. 2am: Purple Melancholia, coconut and lavender for the long walk home. One city, one day, four bottles.

bundles.name: The Boozy Collection
bundles.blurb: Tonight's tab. One rum, neat, in a Brooklyn jazz bar in 2013: Replica Jazz Club, rum and tobacco leaf, exactly as its label remembers. One whisky, blended with a master distiller: Gentleman Réserve Privée, a natural whisky absolute made from Scottish barley, poured over iris and roasted chestnut. One coconut rum out by the fire: Fan Your Flames. And a nightcap, honeyed whiskey over rose and oud: Nefs. Nobody's settling up before 5am.

bundles.name: The Coffeehouse Collection
bundles.blurb: Four orders, one counter. A cold morning in Stockholm, 2007: Replica Coffee Break, coffee with steamed milk and lavender. Something sweet for the table: Or Noir Café, coffee over toffee and cinnamon, finished with vanilla and suede. Green Stravaganza takes its espresso outside to a sunny terrace, bright bergamot over coffee and green vetiver. And Uomo Signature has the seat by the window with the last cup of the day, cinnamon and cardamom warming soft leather. Stay as long as you like.

bundles.name: The Vanilla Collection
bundles.house: Nishane, Parfums de Marly, Armani & Jean Paul Gaultier
bundles.blurb: Vanilla is the fruit of an orchid that blooms for a single day, and almost everywhere it grows, it has to be pollinated by hand. No wonder perfumers treat it like a lead role. Here it plays four. In Ani, Nishane's tribute to a ruined medieval city on the Silk Road, it's spiced with blue ginger and cardamom. Althaïr gives it the depth of Bourbon vanilla, with praline and cinnamon. I Will keeps it hushed, Madagascar vanilla laid over lavender. Le Male Elixir drenches it in honey, tonka and a little tobacco. Four takes on the world's favourite note, and not one of them plain.

bundles.name: The Leather & Suede Collection
bundles.blurb: Leather has a grain you can almost feel through the bottle. Ombré Leather is the broken-in kind, black leather softened with cardamom and jasmine, the jacket you never take off. Tuscan Leather, one of Tom Ford's original Private Blends, is the bold one: raspberry and saffron rubbed into rich leather and black suede. Suède et Safran is the tailored glove, saffron and ginger on the softest suede. The fourth seat is saved for Sospiro Erba Leather, citrus and passion fruit over smooth leather, landing soon.

bundles.name: The Tom Ford Collection
bundles.blurb: Tom Ford built Noir around a man with two sides: the polished one everyone meets, and the darker one very few get to know. These four belong to the man after dark. Noir itself: violet, iris and pink pepper over vanilla, amber and leather. Noir Extreme, richer and creamier, with cardamom, saffron and a kulfi accord. Ombré Leather, black leather and cardamom with the windows down. Oud Minérale, smoky oud and sea salt, the coastline after dark. Dress code: black on black.

bundles.name: The Flower & Stone Collection
bundles.blurb: Some flowers grow out of rock. Café Rose is a Turkish rose that lingered too long in the café: petals steeped in dark coffee, a curl of frankincense rising off the cup. Black Orchid, the first fragrance Tom Ford released under his own name, blooms out of black truffle and patchouli, dark as soil after rain. Then the stones. Terre d'Hermès Intense is earth after a fire, pepper and roasted coffee over a lava-stone accord. Oud Minérale is the shoreline, salt drying on warm rock while smoke drifts in from somewhere inland. Two blossoms, two stones, and the ground that holds them both.

bundles.name: The Saffron Collection
bundles.house: Nishane, Tom Ford, Maison Francis Kurkdjian & Versace
bundles.blurb: Each thread of saffron is picked by hand from a crocus that gives up only three, which is why it costs more by weight than any other spice. Each of these four puts that red gold to work in its own way. Suède et Safran sews it into soft suede with ginger. Noir Extreme melts it into cardamom and a creamy kulfi accord. Baccarat Rouge 540, created for the 250th anniversary of the Baccarat crystal house, lets it glow with jasmine over ambergris and cedar. Eros Najim burns it down to embers of caramel, oud and incense.

bundles.name: The Holiday Spice Collection
bundles.blurb: It's the middle of December. The oven has been on since noon and the windows are fogged. Yellow Dream is the gingerbread cooling on the rack: cinnamon, cardamom and nutmeg over vanilla. Tero is the salted caramel someone keeps stirring, cinnamon bark and warm earth underneath. Ani is the ginger tea steaming on the counter with a soft vanilla glow. Xerjoff Erba Gold is on its way with orange, ginger and warm spice to take the last seat at the table. Stay in; everyone's coming to you.
